description: This file implements the du_low_executor_mapper class, which manages and configures various executor objects for a low-level physical layer in a radio system, including creation, decoration, and configuration of executors with metrics and tracing.

classes.name: executor_decorator
classes.description: Helper class to decorate executors with additional functionalities such as metrics and tracing.

classes.name: du_low_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the du_low_executor_mapper interface, managing executor configuration and creation.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Decorates an executor with metrics, tracing, and synchronization options.

methods.name: get_upper_phy_execution_config
methods.description: Returns the current upper physical layer execution configuration.

methods.name: create_strand
methods.description: Creates a priority task strand on top of a base executor.

methods.name: create_task_fork_limiter
methods.description: Creates a task fork limiter on top of a base executor.

methods.name: wrap_executor_with_metric_tracing
methods.description: Wraps an executor with metric and tracing decorators.
